blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Удары грома и блистания становились ___ (редкий).
exercises.why: The comparative degree of Russian adjectives is formed by adding "**-ее**" (sometimes shortened to "**-ей**") to the stem of the adjective: **новый** — **новее**; **красивый** — **красивее**. This comparative form is the same for all genders and the plural. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 80–81.  ·  From Михаил Булгаков, «Мастер и Маргарита».
